content.short: RollerTap is a tap-to-earn game on TON by the RollerCoin team, bringing mining simulation to Telegram.
content.description: RollerTap is a dedicated 'tap-to-earn' game developed by the experienced team behind the popular RollerCoin mining simulator. It brings the familiar and engaging mechanics of virtual mining to the TON blockchain via a seamless Telegram Mini App. Players accumulate points through simple interactions and social tasks, preparing for airdrops and participating in the project's broader ecosystem. RollerTap leverages the proven success of its predecessors to provide a reliable and entertaining experience for users looking to earn within the TON gaming landscape.
content.meta: Experience mining simulation on Telegram with RollerTap. Tap to earn on TON via Lancers Web3 Explorer.
